### Key Differences

- **Flyby (Recovery)** : Pairs DHM with **electrolytes** (such as sodium, magnesium, and potassium) and other recovery ingredients depending on the formula. It is typically taken **before drinking** , with optional doses after.
- **Cheers (Restore)** : Combines **DHM** with **L-cysteine** and plant extracts like **prickly pear** and **milk thistle** . It is typically taken **after your last drink** or before bed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXBEPaMjD3CQbfVRwEkzddo0IzW1tjHtGnnwa1tlloSxNsM9lkRLw2924eixhqDAaTYWS1XxX9vc2laHsKSxXD89rZHdqozxDBNdTnINhJpIS45RrZ5xrjU0fr2laP)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXBpdnfMyq3FU2JprbrQQL9shl4wzukIhXr6VxXLpuMJUxEfYvY_1zbmTPEQDsT8DuYfdrBuQh5gN0g_SQhxc_Nu1imCmsfNUfIh3ad6v1Yhtd1b3o-aD1cP-2u44T05-oA3UFjTf9YGTN)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXKLd24tqylm13obDRV3D8TLFTvk7YiOx135j6lazL3D_gBqXnCQSrM0iaIcouBygohCv-l3WfQRYTNkhWk74g0hzoOEgp3TV6Ip6pBINroJ_N2IVOFfxTOgmPPVpRJr958qH3oWAYNA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXgV83P7ujylyrp-NXLv434yvzn-Sxq-JaHPvBZi438o_EWQzT7oFCAAHW9yKL0aGxMK8MeSuHCkPtlKcxB3gcQmP1APNOAKZqXdoMicJw15SaWfdUqNhKtr1WlpaTLsIHxtAi0EM8-9wkPzPz)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXQ8VVaRIXm38RL_rQBGy2iM2HByNJaKyD-lGTf3fP-2Cef2uzZSxbe-j3wP2VDXFgH5jE0--e2ttBC-0gDv4Ri4A_LPoTHL6gdS4xtvFUzgRpU6PmuyUY0yBrHByuFUe54Qle)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXw_OqEc18hWAAfnAbKNOo8UTXF-_nXArJfg6STsLmMRUkP8lkBgOIK1nXhaYn1H8B1DxeYep33glq4Hj2YYJonaOTRMdEZsFr0i3YnpKR6bAxoD9xT_negQu-WJfhOVHrvYxg)[[7]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXSS0fc4F1OubqUhK605a1u2E2eVGs3n-Zz_KaHE18HgEqmULZqjzGoWOyeIh2VzLF5BHTRAvdx1QWtJfg-XXUQHsTmoOyeZW22ZFAA2aTDpc86tvnFPoeAXaa27XPC_LCQUUybO2Sj4iP)
